messages:
incidentbot: ALERT: edge-proxy amplification detected. Rapid fanout to /v1/embeddings and /v1/chat from small IP clusters in ap-southeast-1. Spike started ~2026-03-17T14:00Z. 12k req/s peak, backend 5xx rising, token generation queueing. Suspected proxy amplification (large Cookie + repeated X-Forwarded-For patterns).

alice_m: who’s oncall for infra right now? page went out but want confirmation.

oncall_lead: I got paged and I'm on it. seeing 5xx and 429 increase on edge and embeddings. working hypothesis matches incidentbot.

ben_sre: quick mitigation plan (apply ASAP):
1) enable edge circuit breaker for /v1/embeddings: per-src conn limit 150r/s, drop above with 429. (reduce fanout)
2) add WAF rule to block fingerprint: UA regex "python-requests|curl/" + cookie-length > 1k. Block list by ASN for immediate stop.
3) tighten per-api-key quota for non-enterprise plans (slice daily->hourly for embeddings).
4) disable batch/async embeddings ingestion endpoint (will pause any queueing amplification).
5) enable short-term global prefix-KV cache bypass to avoid backend cache stampede.

carla_prod: CX: a couple of paying EU customers reporting degraded embeddings latency. prefer throttles not full blocks for enterprise customers. we need allowlist for known customer API keys.

ops_jordi: applying WAF rule now and flipping circuit-breaker toggle. pushing config:
```
edge-config set circuit_breaker /v1/embeddings --max-rps 150 --action 429
waf rule create --name "edge-amplify-fingerprint-98321" --match "ua:/(python-requests|curl)/ || cookie.len>1024" --action block
feature toggle embeddings-batch --off
```

incidentbot: mitigation actions applied: waf=98321 (blocking), circuit-breaker enabled on /v1/embeddings, embeddings-batch toggled OFF. Monitoring windows: 1m/5m/15m.

alice_m: dashboards show 5xx rate dropping, edge token generation backlog down ~58% in last 6m. Good early signal.

ben_sre: great. next steps: 1) compile short customer impact note for CX (carla) 2) start a quick blameless incident doc 3) schedule followup at 18:00Z to review if we should re-enable batch. Also escalate to security for source attribution.

carla_prod: I'll draft customer comms with partial throttle explanation and expected timeline. will include allowlist request form for enterprise keys.

maria_night: I'm taking handoff at 15:00Z — ack'ing this incident and notes. I'll keep alerts on and rollback waf only if false positive confirmed. ping me on DM if any flare.

ben_sre: handing to @maria_night. tagging postmortem_owner: ben_sre. Note: collect sample request headers for forensics (store in secure bucket).

incidentbot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations stable. No new surge for 12m. Will keep thread open for final close after postmortem created.

alice_m: +1. Thanks team. :thumbsup
